title: Lesson 44: Enterprise Integration: Connecting Agents to Salesforce, ERP, CRM, and Data Warehouses
description: Separating the read path from the write path, the three shapes of enterprise connection, governed data-warehouse reads, safe CRM/ERP writes, and identity as the security boundary.

questions.question: When connecting an agent to a system of record, what should be decided first?
options: Whether each call is a read or a write, since the two paths need separate identities, permissions, and guardrails
Which specific SDK, connector, or API endpoint will be used to physically carry the connection to the target system
Which cloud region or data center the target system happens to run inside
Which language model will be responsible for generating the agent's tool calls
questions.explanation: Reads accept a narrower identity and smaller blast radius than writes, so the two paths need separate identities, permissions, and guardrails and should be designed as distinct integrations.

questions.question: On the read path into a data warehouse, what keeps the agent inside the system's existing governance?
options: Give the agent a raw SQL execution shell so that it can query whatever data it decides that it needs directly
Trust the agent's own prompt to avoid asking for data that it is not permitted to see
Expose a governed analyst tool over semantic views, keep it read-only, and scope it to a least-privileged role
Let the agent read only from a local cached copy of the warehouse tables instead
questions.explanation: The store already governs its data, so the agent should reach it through a read-only analyst tool over governed views and a least-privileged role rather than a raw shell that bypasses those controls.

questions.question: How should the write path into a CRM or ERP be designed?
options: Write directly to the raw database records so that the agent keeps the broadest freedom and operational flexibility
Prefer a governed platform action, and place a human confirmation in front of any destructive or irreversible write
Share the read path's identity and grants so there is only one credential to manage
Skip any confirmation step so that writes can complete as quickly as possible
questions.explanation: A write changes shared business state, so it should go through a governed action that applies business rules and stop for human confirmation when the effect is irreversible.
